newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil imports to go on-line to speed up trade.
newsitem.headline: Brazil imports to go on-line to speed up trade.

text.p: A new computer system to register Brazilian imports will come on line January 2, finally doing away with time-consuming and often costly paperwork, a Central Bank official said.
"This will simplify and modernize the registering of imports," Jose Maria Ferreira Carvalho, head of the bank's exchange department, said.
Brazilian exports are already registered by computer and the move to include imports should help reduce the cost of doing business in Brazil, Ferreira said.

The Central Bank hopes to extend the computerized register to include foreign direct investment in the first half of next year. Overseas borrowing by Brazilian companies may also be included at a later date.
